description: Latest tweets of up to 50 X users in one call, by numeric user id: count tweets for each user, newest first. One entry per user, in input order. 1 credit per tweet. A user with no public tweets is an empty list and costs nothing. To read more of one user, pass the next_cursor of the entry to get_user_tweets.

count.description: Tweets for each user, 1 to 20. Default 3.

fresh.description: Read X again and skip the cache. Costs 2x credits for an item that has a cached copy, the normal price for one that has none.

ids.description: 1 to 50 numeric user ids. get_users gives the id of a handle.

name: get_users_tweets
title: User tweets, batch
